en: An old monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate three‑story stone school building with a central arched entrance and symmetrical wings. The façade features many tall windows, decorative cornices, and a prominent central section with columns above the main arch. Small trees line the front, and there is an open street or square in the foreground. Swedish text is printed at the top identifying the building and the city.
